<!-- ===== MOTOR FX three.js (cyber/HUD) — monta <div class="tic-fx" data-fx="..."> ===== -->
<!-- Presets: network · particles · terrain · rings · hexspin. Fondo transparente, neón sobre gris claro.
     Pausa fuera de viewport (IntersectionObserver). Fallback poster (data-poster) en reduced-motion / sin WebGL. -->
<script type="module">
(function(){
  if(window.__TICFX__) return; window.__TICFX__ = 1;
  const reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const NEON=0x00a8ff, BRIGHT=0x21d4ff, DEEP=0x0066cc, GRID=0xcbd3da;
  let THREE = null;

  function roundTex(T){
    const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=64;const x=c.getContext('2d');
    const g=x.createRadialGradient(32,32,0,32,32,32);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,1)');g.addColorStop(.3,'rgba(255,255,255,.85)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
    x.fillStyle=g;x.beginPath();x.arc(32,32,32,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
    const t=new T.CanvasTexture(c);return t;
  }
  function poster(el){const u=el.getAttribute('data-poster');if(u){const i=document.createElement('img');i.src=u;i.alt='';i.style.cssText='width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block';el.appendChild(i);}}

  // ---- Presets: cada uno devuelve {update(t,dt), objects} y agrega a `scene`. ----
  function buildNetwork(T, scene, col){
    const g=new T.Group(); scene.add(g);
    const N=46, R=1.5, P=[];
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){P.push(new T.Vector3((Math.sin(i*12.9)*43758.5)%1*2*R-R,(Math.sin(i*78.2)*12543.7)%1*2*R-R,(Math.sin(i*37.7)*9517.3)%1*1.6-0.8));}
    const pos=new Float32Array(N*3); P.forEach((p,i)=>{pos[i*3]=p.x;pos[i*3+1]=p.y;pos[i*3+2]=p.z;});
    const pgeo=new T.BufferGeometry(); pgeo.setAttribute('position',new T.BufferAttribute(pos,3));
    const pmat=new T.PointsMaterial({color:BRIGHT,size:0.12,map:roundTex(T),transparent:true,depthWrite:false,opacity:0.95});
    g.add(new T.Points(pgeo,pmat));
    const seg=[]; for(let i=0;i<N;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<N;j++){if(P[i].distanceTo(P[j])<0.95){seg.push(P[i],P[j]);}}
    const lgeo=new T.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(seg);
    const lmat=new T.LineBasicMaterial({color:col,transparent:true,opacity:0.5});
    g.add(new T.LineSegments(lgeo,lmat));
    return {update:(t)=>{g.rotation.y=t*0.00018;g.rotation.x=Math.sin(t*0.00012)*0.22;lmat.opacity=0.32+0.18*Math.sin(t*0.0012);}};
  }
  function buildParticles(T, scene, col){
    const N=620, R=2.2, pos=new Float32Array(N*3), sp=new Float32Array(N);
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){pos[i*3]=(Math.sin(i*12.9)*43758.5%1)*2*R-R;pos[i*3+1]=(Math.sin(i*4.1)*1733.7%1)*2*R-R;pos[i*3+2]=(Math.sin(i*7.3)*5417.3%1)*2-1;sp[i]=0.15+(Math.sin(i*9.7)*1000%1)*0.5;}
    const geo=new T.BufferGeometry(); geo.setAttribute('position',new T.BufferAttribute(pos,3));
    const mat=new T.PointsMaterial({color:col,size:0.05,map:roundTex(T),transparent:true,depthWrite:false,opacity:0.9});
    const pts=new T.Points(geo,mat); scene.add(pts);
    return {update:(t,dt)=>{const a=geo.attributes.position.array;for(let i=0;i<N;i++){a[i*3+1]-=sp[i]*dt*0.0006;if(a[i*3+1]<-R)a[i*3+1]=R;}geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;pts.rotation.y=t*0.00006;}};
  }
  function buildTerrain(T, scene, col){
    const g=new T.Group(); g.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2.5; g.rotation.z=0.1; scene.add(g);
    const W=42,Hh=22, geo=new T.PlaneGeometry(4.6,2.6,W,Hh);
    const base=geo.attributes.position.array.slice();
    const mat=new T.MeshBasicMaterial({color:col,wireframe:true,transparent:true,opacity:0.5});
    g.add(new T.Mesh(geo,mat));
    return {update:(t)=>{const a=geo.attributes.position.array;for(let i=0;i<a.length;i+=3){const x=base[i],y=base[i+1];a[i+2]=Math.sin(x*2.2+t*0.0014)*0.16+Math.cos(y*2.6+t*0.0011)*0.16;}geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;mat.opacity=0.34+0.18*Math.sin(t*0.0010);}};
  }
  function buildRings(T, scene, col){
    const g=new T.Group(); scene.add(g);
    const mk=(r,tube,c,op)=>{const m=new T.Mesh(new T.TorusGeometry(r,tube,12,80),new T.MeshBasicMaterial({color:c,transparent:true,opacity:op}));g.add(m);return m;};
    const a=mk(1.25,0.006,col,0.8), b=mk(0.95,0.004,BRIGHT,0.6), c=mk(1.55,0.003,DEEP,0.4);
    a.rotation.x=1.1; b.rotation.y=0.8; c.rotation.x=0.5;
    const ico=new T.Mesh(new T.IcosahedronGeometry(0.55,1),new T.MeshBasicMaterial({color:col,wireframe:true,transparent:true,opacity:0.5})); g.add(ico);
    const dots=new T.Points(new T.IcosahedronGeometry(0.55,1),new T.PointsMaterial({color:BRIGHT,size:0.06,map:roundTex(T),transparent:true,depthWrite:false})); g.add(dots);
    return {update:(t)=>{a.rotation.z=t*0.0005;b.rotation.z=-t*0.0007;c.rotation.z=t*0.0003;ico.rotation.y=t*0.0006;ico.rotation.x=t*0.0004;dots.rotation.copy(ico.rotation);}};
  }
  function buildHexspin(T, scene, col){
    const g=new T.Group(); scene.add(g);
    const seg=[]; const rings=4;
    for(let r=1;r<=rings;r++){const rad=r*0.42, k=6*r;for(let i=0;i<k;i++){const a0=(i/k)*Math.PI*2, a1=((i+1)/k)*Math.PI*2;seg.push(new T.Vector3(Math.cos(a0)*rad,Math.sin(a0)*rad,0),new T.Vector3(Math.cos(a1)*rad,Math.sin(a1)*rad,0));}}
    const lm=new T.LineBasicMaterial({color:col,transparent:true,opacity:0.45});
    g.add(new T.LineSegments(new T.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(seg),lm));
    const pgeo=new T.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(seg.filter((_,i)=>i%2===0));
    g.add(new T.Points(pgeo,new T.PointsMaterial({color:BRIGHT,size:0.05,map:roundTex(T),transparent:true,depthWrite:false})));
    return {update:(t)=>{g.rotation.z=t*0.00022;lm.opacity=0.3+0.2*Math.sin(t*0.0013);}};
  }
  const PRESETS={network:buildNetwork,particles:buildParticles,terrain:buildTerrain,rings:buildRings,hexspin:buildHexspin};

  async function setup(el){
    if(reduce){poster(el);return;}
    if(!THREE){try{THREE=await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/build/three.module.js');}catch(e){poster(el);return;}}
    let renderer; try{renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true,alpha:true});}catch(e){poster(el);return;}
    const w=el.clientWidth||400, h=el.clientHeight||300;
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,1.6)); renderer.setSize(w,h);
    renderer.domElement.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); renderer.domElement.style.display='block'; el.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
    const scene=new THREE.Scene();
    const cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45,w/h,0.1,100); cam.position.set(0,0,3.2);
    const colAttr=el.getAttribute('data-color'); const col=colAttr?parseInt(colAttr.replace('#','0x')):NEON;
    const fx=(PRESETS[el.getAttribute('data-fx')]||buildNetwork)(THREE,scene,col);
    let raf=0, last=0, visible=true;
    const io=new IntersectionObserver((es)=>{visible=es[0].isIntersecting;},{threshold:0.01}); io.observe(el);
    function frame(t){raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);const dt=Math.min(50,t-last);last=t;if(!visible)return;fx.update(t,dt);renderer.render(scene,cam);}
    raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    new ResizeObserver(()=>{const W=el.clientWidth,H=el.clientHeight;if(!W||!H)return;cam.aspect=W/H;cam.updateProjectionMatrix();renderer.setSize(W,H);}).observe(el);
  }
  function mountAll(){document.querySelectorAll('.tic-fx:not([data-fxi])').forEach(el=>{el.setAttribute('data-fxi','1');setup(el);});}
  if(document.readyState==='loading'){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>setTimeout(mountAll,80));}else{setTimeout(mountAll,80);}
  window.addEventListener('load',()=>setTimeout(mountAll,200));
})();
</script>
